summary: Fixes solid slicing tolerance handling in Part::CrossSection and Area::makeSections, removes the 0.001 mm slice offset and the PocketShape GeometryTolerance extrusion buffer, and wraps OCCT ConnectEdgesToWires/ConnectWiresToWires to work around an OCCT bug, so Pocket Shape and Mill Face once again cut to full depth without any change to properties, defaults, task-panel controls or commands.

pages.reason: Area.cpp makeSections: internal slice-tolerance fix and removal of the 0.001 offset workaround; no Area property, default or enumeration changes
PocketShape.py areaOpShapes: removes internal GeometryTolerance/10 extrusion buffer; a crash/bug fix restoring the documented full-depth behaviour, no property or panel change
